entries.name: ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN
entries.description: An Asana access token the connector reads projects, sections, tasks and comments with. A personal access token can do anything its user can in Asana and can't be limited, so make it as a user who sees only the projects to sync. An OAuth app's token limited to read scopes is the safer choice. The connector only sends its own reads either way.
howToGet: Sign in to Asana as a user who can see the projects to sync and no more, such as a guest or member added only to those projects.
Open the developer console (My apps), choose Create new token under personal access tokens, and name it KaratOS.
Copy the token straight into the host's secret store. Asana shows it once. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: ASANA_WORKSPACE_GID
entries.description: The id of the one Asana workspace to read. Unset reads every workspace the token's user belongs to.
howToGet: Open any project in the workspace and ask the client's Asana admin for the workspace id, or open https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/users/me signed in as the token's user and copy the gid of the workspace to read.
